content.short: Allbridge Core enables cross-chain swaps of native stablecoins.
content.description: Allbridge Core enables the transfer of value between blockchains by facilitating cross-chain swaps of native stablecoins across multiple networks. By operating as a messaging protocol agnostic layer, it connects a broad range of ecosystems, spanning both EVM-compatible and non-EVM networks, to support interoperable transfers of assets. Across supported networks such as Ethereum, BNB Chain, Solana, and Multichain, Allbridge Core provides a unified pathway for moving liquidity and stable-asset value across chains, without depending on a single messaging standard.
